scope: HTTP app route registration templates and network/cache/poll call sites. Registration templates are not expanded endpoint counts. Direct call flags do not establish final auth/cache behavior.

clientCallSites.args:
`${apiBaseUrl()}/v1/client-errors`, {
      method: 'POST',
      keepalive: true,
      credentials: 'omit',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...apiAuth().headers },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    }

`${apiBaseUrl()}/v1/acquisition${action ? '' : '/consent'}`, {
      ...auth,
      method: action ? 'POST' : 'GET',
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
      headers: { ...auth.headers, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      ...(action ? { body: JSON.stringify({ version, ...action }) } : {}),
    }
